description: Lightweight repository pre-tool approval hook for agent-executed terminal commands. This file is repository policy and should not be edited by agents without explicit approval.
askMessage: This command is classified as a risky git operation. Please present the exact command and a one-sentence rationale and wait for explicit approval in the current chat before executing.
notes: This hook is advisory: the actual enforcement depends on the agent runtime (VS Code Copilot hook support). Keep it narrowly scoped to agent tool calls. Do not modify without human approval.
